purpose: Add the historical stock 14.1.5 nullable report-group CATEGORY compatibility column; current production also lacks it. No business values or permission backfill.
transformations: Extract only CATEGORY VARCHAR2(36 BYTE), nullable without default, from source CREATE TABLE into qualified ALTER TABLE ADD; preserve existing seven runtime columns and row values.
Retain original CATEGORY comment; verify exact local owner/container and seven-column shape before DDL.
Equivalent eight-column shape with exact CATEGORY comment and no CATEGORY constraints returns without DDL; incompatible or partial shape is rejected.

semantics.parent_CATEGORY_dictionary: reportCategory common/select; no parent CATEGORY default or backfill found in tracked project SQL.
semantics.permissions: Stock tree mapper role-permission OR branches additionally require CATEGORY=select and ACTIVATEDFLAG=1. NULL does not satisfy those branches. Original UI separately filters category_SEQ=select.
semantics.existing_rows: Adding a nullable column without DEFAULT leaves existing rows NULL. Do not assign select/common/reportlet or infer values from REPORTCONFIGCATEGORY.
semantics.distinct_fields: REPORTCONFIGCATEGORY is a project ext$ classification. Child REPORTCATEGORY has source reportlet backfill; that does not apply to parent CATEGORY.
semantics.attribution: 2026-11-09 production metadata and both test snapshots lack CATEGORY. The historical 14.1.5 release SQL and stock Mapper require it: this is an application/schema version-contract difference, not evidence of a production column lost during import. Retain the local column as an explicit stock compatibility extension.

limits: Oracle DDL implicitly commits; this fixture is not atomic and cannot claim transaction rollback. Use a dedicated session without pending DML.
The first seven columns are pinned to the actual local runtime preflight, not replaced with the older complete CREATE TABLE definition.
Do not run on baseline, production or supplier schemas; owner/container guards admit only the named local runtime.
Run existing source-pinning verification before SQL review/application; coordinate inactive verification and capture original-column row/content hashes outside this fixture.
No baseline refresh, policy/helper extension, seed creation, permission grant, external report execution, app refresh or API evidence promotion.
If ADD succeeds but COMMENT fails, retain the error and inspect partial schema; rerun rejects incomplete metadata rather than repairing silently.
Positive report-tree and no-match HTTP must be rerun after authorized application; category-filtered positives remain unknown without explicit legitimate configuration.
